Case reference: 2014006276.CaseDesc: On September 25, 2013, Mohamed Ali Qazi was seen for the last time in Montreal, Quebec. At the time of his disappearance, Mohamed was in a Chevrolet Malibu rental vehicle that was later located in a shopping center in the city of Terrebonne, Quebec. His friend, Pierre Daniel, was also reported missing. The two men were often together.

Case reference: 2025011842.CaseDesc: Gabriel Simard was reported missing as of March 11, 2025, in the waters of the St. Lawrence River near Les Bergeronnes, Quebec. Gabriel departed from the municipal dock with his 16-foot canoe to retrieve his fishing cabin from the waters of the river. At approximately 6:00 p.m., Gabriel contacted his father via mobile phone to inform him that he was unable to tow the cabin back to shore due to the strong winds. An hour later, Gabriel contacted his father once more to request that he contact the emergency services, as he was unable to return to the dock and was being swept towards the open sea. Despite a thorough search, the whereabouts of Gabriel remain unknown.

Jacket: Synthetic, Brown, Black, Camouflage, hunting vest

Case reference: 2015019929.CaseDesc: On April 16, at approximately 9:00 a.m., Sribavan Kandasamy was seen for the last time in Toronto, Ontario.

Case reference: 2024004350.CaseDesc: Lijun Su was last seen by his family at approximately 6:30 am, on January 27,2024. On that day a surge of river water and ice occurred on the Saugeen River in the town of Saugeen Shores / Southampton, Ontario. It is believed that Lijun was fishing on the Saugeen river and was taken away with the ice and water surge.

Case reference: 2014003940.CaseDesc: On August 30, 1999, Dana Zelic was seen for the last time at her mother's residence located in Hamilton, Ontario. Dana was known to have connections in the Greater Toronto area and in Brooklyn, New York, in the United States. At the time of her disappearance, Dana left her mother’s home without her medication, identification or personal belongings. All efforts to locate her have returned negative results.

Mark: Left Side Of Neck, Brown beauty mark

Case reference: 2014001413.CaseDesc: On September 18, 1959, Captain Charles David Tillsley, Warrant Officer Tyrus Cobb, Sergeant Major James Mackey, and a fourth companion left Fort Churchill on a weekend fishing trip on the Churchill River in Manitoba. They were last seen loading their gear into a boat at the Churchill Dock at around 1 p.m. They were due back on September 20, but failed to return. Fort Churchill's military authorities commenced a search with the aid of helicopters and aircraft. On September 21, the two boats used by the men were located; both were undamaged and swamped. Numerous items belonging to the four men were found. Despite extensive land and water searches, the bodies were not found.

Case reference: 2015011636.CaseDesc: On June 20, 1998, a fisherman saw the body of a man floating in the St. Lawrence River in front of L'Île aux Vaches, Quebec.

Case reference: 2015011654.CaseDesc: On December 3, 1994, a baby was found in the Rivière des Prairies between the island of Montréal and the Visitation park Island in the Ahuntsic neighborhood. The body was naked and had a plastic bag wrapped around the wrist. According to experts the body would have been in the water since the fall.

Case reference: 2005001799.CaseDesc: On June 1, 1975, the body of an older adult female was located on the west bank of the Niagara River, in the town of Niagara-on-the-Lake. She is believed to be the same person who was witnessed jumping into the Horseshoe Falls on February 17, 1975. She is thought to be 40 plus years, short and heavy-set, with brown hair. She suffered from lung disease and had severe arthritis of her lumbar spine, which may have been painful. When witnessed going over the Falls, she was wearing a long overcoat, possibly grey, and carrying a green umbrella. There is no confirmation that the jumper and the deceased are the same person, however the general descriptions are in agreement. The condition of her remains suggest that she had been in the water for weeks to months.

Teeth: This female probably had a partial dental plate and still retained a gold crown on her right upper canine tooth.

Case reference: 2014004619.CaseDesc: William "Billy Jay" Sharphead was last seen leaving his residence on the Enoch Cree Nation in Alberta, in September of 2003.  On that night it is believed that he got into a car.  He has not been seen since.

Case reference: 2014005236.CaseDesc: On May 30, 1973, Françoise Guilbault reportedly left her home in Joliette, Quebec. She left a note for her husband and took a bus to Montreal, Quebec. Françoise has never been seen since.

Case reference: 2014004917.CaseDesc: Robert Rudish and Lee Vrba arrived in Island Lake Manitoba on June 11, 1972, to fish. On June 17, RCMP received a report that a canoe was found overturned in the water. The canoe was soon identified as belonging to Lee. RCMP Investigators surmised the men went missing on either the Thursday or the Friday. The weather on both days was extreme, with high winds gusting to 30 mph, which caused the lake to be quite rough. Neither of the two men have been located and it is presumed both drowned.

Tattoo: tattoo on right or left forearm

Case reference: 2015049567.CaseDesc: Raymond Chalifoux was last seen on May 25th, 2015 at the Fort St John Hospital. Mr. Chalifoux received abdominal surgery and left the hospital against the advice of medical staff. He left in an unknown direction. Extensive searches were conducted with negative results. Mr. Chalifoux has not been seen or heard from since.

Vest: Black, Black vest with designs on chest

Case reference: 2014003107.CaseDesc: Jean Fournier was last seen in Montreal, Quebec on August 30, 1993. Jean was very stressed and depressed at the time of his disappearance and he left a letter for his wife stating that he was leaving all of his belongings to her. Jean left his house with little money in his pocket.

Case reference: 2013000029.CaseDesc: Leslie Anne Katnick was reported missing by her father on November 4, 1991, to Montreal Police. Leslie had been residing in Montreal, Quebec until November 1, 1991, which was the last time she was seen by either friends or family. The investigation revealed that Leslie registered into the Halifax, Nova Scotia YMCA on November 2, 1991, for several nights and returned the key on November 4, 1991. No further information has surfaced with respect to the whereabouts of Leslie. The circumstances of her disappearance are suspicious and foul play may be involved.

Case reference: 2020009578.CaseDesc: On May 18, 1989, at approximately 1:00am, Andrew Gunzinger was seen for the last time leaving his girlfriend’s father’s farm near Orangeville, Ontario. Prior to leaving, Andrew and his girlfriend had gotten into a dispute.

Case reference: 2013000101.CaseDesc: Oswald Bear departed from his parents' residence in Peguis First Nation, Manitoba on October 19, 1969 with the intention of harvesting wood in a nearby forest. Oswald was well-acquainted with the area and enjoyed the task of chopping wood. He had spent a considerable amount of time in the area and was intimately familiar with it. He had never been lost in the bush and had never failed to return home previously. At 6:15 p.m., he visited his sister's residence, which was located nearby. His sister advised him to return home shortly thereafter to alleviate their mother's concern. Oswald left his sister's residence with the intention of returning home, but he was not seen again.

Case reference: 2014004511.CaseDesc: On July 29, 2004 George Davis left a residence near Creston, BC to get cigarettes. He was driving a 1981 brown Chrysler Lebaron with a British Columbia licence plate. The vehicle has not been recovered.

Case reference: 2014003215.CaseDesc: On June 24, 1972, a group of seven people, including Hank Ethier, were fishing on the Burntwood River. Late in the day the group and their two boats went to shore for supper. One group, which included Hank, left the shore. They were however unable to get their boat started and as a result they began to drift backwards towards the rapids. This group called for help and the other boat went to their aid. Hank jumped from his boat and swam to the second one. Once they reached the disabled boat everyone was told to get in. Both boats encountered the rapids. It is assumed Hank drowned as a result of the mishap.

Case reference: 2014005499.CaseDesc: During the early morning hours of Friday, October 1st, 2010, Janice Cher Desjarlais and her boyfriend crawled into a dumpster located behind The Center of Hope on Franklin Avenue in Fort McMurray. Janice's boyfriend advised that he left at approximately 7:30 a.m. to go to McDonald’s restaurant. When he returned at around 8:30 a.m., Janice was gone. When he was unable to find her, he suspected that the dumpster may have been emptied during his absence. On October 3rd, video surveillance of the area confirmed that the dumpster had been picked up at 8:22 a.m. on October 1st. It also showed the departure of Janice's boyfriend, but no one else entering or leaving the dumpster. On October 5th, a major excavation of the landfill was started, but by the time the search was completed on October 14th, Janice had not been located.

Case reference: 2014005032.CaseDesc: Edward Dufresne was last seen on April 12, 1993 at his home in Ste-Félicité, Quebec and was reported missing by his neighbour. Edward lived alone in a small house on Route 132, and he was known to regularly walk along the roads, pick mussels by the water, and go hunt for small game in the forest.

Chain: Silver, Aluminum, Stainless Steel, With keys tied to a string

Case reference: 2014005809.CaseDesc: On June 8, 2012, Martha Kelly was last seen walking near her residence in Perth-Andover, New-Brunswick. Martha suffered a brain injury in the past, leaving her at times with short term memory problems. Martha has not been seen or heard from since.

Case reference: 2014005873.CaseDesc: On August 31, 2012, Mark Pearson left his residence in Coaticook, Quebec. Searches have led police to believe that Mark could possibly have fallen in the Coaticook River near the intersection of Child and St. Paul East streets in Coaticook, Quebec. He was reported missing on September 7, 2012.

Sweater: Cotton, Blue, T-shirt with "Puma" on the front

Case reference: 2014003404.CaseDesc: Armand Comtois was reported missing on May 2, 1985. At the time of his disappearance he was living in Saint-Hyacinthe, Quebec. He was seen by a family member on March 9, 1985 but he has not been seen or heard from since this date. He also used the name of "Simon".

Teeth: Dental appliance, partial composed of 4 upper teeth.

Case reference: 2017064837.CaseDesc: On November 2, 2017, at approximately 2:00 a.m., Mélissa Blais was seen for the last time in Louiseville, Quebec. Prior to her disappearance, Mélissa had driven to Louiseville’s downtown area in her 2011 black Toyota Corolla, license plate Quebec Y70 FAD, to spend the evening there. Her vehicle has never been found.

Tattoo: Left Shoulder, Heart and wings; letters "JO"

Case reference: 2014001255.CaseDesc: On October 28, 1979, Robert Caldicott last spoke with his father on the telephone. Mr. Caldicott failed to attend several appointments in the following days.

Case reference: 2014003978.CaseDesc: Ernest Robert Pfaff left home at approximately 8pm on December 31, 1973 to purchase a loaf of bread. He was driving a 1972 Ford Maverick, light blue in colour, with red pin stripes on the sides.

Coat: Grey, Three quarter length pile coat

Case reference: 2014003322.CaseDesc: Anne Matthews was last seen on December 8, 1983, at the Homewood Health Centre, in Ontario.  An extensive search was conducted of the area and the river where footprints were located.

Coat: Red, Black, Felt coat with black embroidery bottom and a fox fur hood

Case reference: 2014002692.CaseDesc: Between September 3 and October 3, 1978, Jean-Jacques Sirois was seen for the last time in the Rosemont District in Montreal, Quebec. Jean-Jacques has not been seen or heard from since.

Jewelry: Gold, Gold ring with rectangular cubic zirconia
